iMinRepeatPlayer.comment: Base minimum turns between Occurrences of this class for each player. Can be modified by Occurrence Level

iMaxPendingTurns.comment: Pending Occurrences will expire after this many turns

bBalanceDistribution.comment: If enabled, the game will attempt to more evenly distribute Occurrence types as well as players affected

aeOccurrenceLevels.comment: A list of OccurrenceLevels that will be available as game options when starting a new game
